name: jotpatch
description: Tiny local-first paper notes pinned to webpage text.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.content.json && tsc -p tsconfig.background.json && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: python tests/browser_e2e.py && python tests/conversation_e2e.py && python tests/optimization_e2e.py && python tests/virtualized_notes_e2e.py && python tests/rail_navigation_e2e.py
